thread:
Ravi: Heads-up, CS reported a tenant seeing v1 responses while clearly sending v2 headers. No console hint and invoice mismatch.
Elena: Which tenant/time?
Ravi: tenant-62, 17:1017:18 UTC. Logs show `incoming:x-api-version=2` but `routed_version=1` repeatedly. Reason label `fallback=capacity`.
ops-bot: metric: implicit_route_switch{tenant="tenant-62"} +29 in 8m.
Sam: We have several related threads but this case highlights billing visibility lacking. We need routed-version annotated billing lines.
Mina: Agreed. Proposal: emit `version_routing_event{tenant,route,incoming_version,routed_version,reason}` and tag invoices with `routed_version` for that billing window.
Elena: Console UX: prefer a small per-tenant indicator, not a global banner. Maybe a pill: "routing parity: 83%" that expands to show recent downgrades.
Ravi: For alerts, start probe-only for 48h. Rule idea: `sum by (tenant) (increase(implicit_route_switch[10m])) > 10 and increase(implicit_route_switch[10m]) > 2 * median_over_time(increase(implicit_route_switch[10m])[7d:1m])`.
Sam: Add a semantic weighting per-route (embeddings>rerank>chat) so alerts prioritize high-risk endpoints.
Mina: CS asks for automatic audit events when a tenant experiences >20 silent downgrades in 10m, include up to 50 sample request IDs and trace links.
Elena: Also include prescriptive remediation text in alert payload: check autoscaler, recent model variants, and `pin-route` command example.
Ravi: I'll draft the Prom rules and billing annotation schema. Mina can draft the audit event schema. Sam, can you mock the pill UI?
Sam: On it. I'll use subtle colors and a tooltip: "Routing parity shows percent of requests honoring requested API version."
ops-bot: Note: metric `version_routing_event` proposed (dry-run).
Elena: Good work. Let's run probe-mode this weekend and reconvene Monday to adjust thresholds.
